screen.coverage_note: screened N windows sampled from bare land (X% coverage); not 'all of Earth'

extended.note: original 13 + documented agency-cited hold-outs (deduplicated within 20 km)
extended.overlap_note: the extended-set AUC partly overlaps the selection set (it contains the original 13); heldout_positive_indep = documented hold-outs not within 20 km of the original 13 is the independent test

independent.note: documented agency hold-outs NOT within 20 km of the original 13 (never used for selection)

validation.feature_selection_note: shape rim term excluded because it lowered known-vs-decoy AUC (0.80 -> 0.70); selection used the original 13 known analogs

nasadem_check.note: NASADEM near field (56S-60N) + same GLO-90 far field; sites north of 60N are Copernicus-only (available: false)
